questions.question: 특정 릴리스에서 완료된 TR 목록은?
questions.cypher:
MATCH (tr:TechnicalReport)-[:TARGET_RELEASE]->(r:Release)
                  WHERE r.releaseName = 'Rel-17' AND tr.trStatus = 'Completed'
                  RETURN tr.trNumber, tr.trTitle ORDER BY tr.trNumber

questions.question: 전체 TR의 Status 분포는?
questions.cypher: MATCH (tr:TechnicalReport) RETURN tr.trStatus, count(tr) AS cnt ORDER BY cnt DESC

questions.question: 특정 TR이 영향 준 TS 목록은?
특정 TR의 ImpactType은?
questions.cypher:
MATCH (tr:TechnicalReport {trNumber: '38.801'})-[:HAS_TR_IMPACT]->(imp:TRImpact)
                  RETURN imp.impactType, imp.evidenceStatus, count(imp) AS cnt, collect(DISTINCT imp.verifiedImpactScope) AS verifiedScopes
questions.claim_contract: Stored claim inventory: return the declared impact type together with evidenceStatus; pending/rejected records are not established incorporation.

                  WHERE imp.impactType = 'NewTS'
                  RETURN DISTINCT tr.trNumber, tr.trTitle, imp.impactType, imp.evidenceStatus, imp.verifiedImpactScope

questions.question: 38.401에 영향 준 TR 목록은?
questions.cypher: MATCH (tr:TechnicalReport)-[:HAS_TR_IMPACT]->(imp:TRImpact{evidenceStatus: 'source_verified'})-[:IMPACTS_SPEC]->(s:Spec {specNumber: '38.401'}) RETURN tr.trNumber, imp.impactType, imp.impactDescription, imp.verifiedImpactScope

questions.question: 38.823가 어떤 TS에 영향?
questions.cypher:
MATCH (tr:TechnicalReport {trNumber: '38.823'})-[:HAS_TR_IMPACT]->(imp:TRImpact{evidenceStatus: 'source_verified'})-[:IMPACTS_SPEC]->(s:Spec)
                  RETURN s.specNumber, imp.impactType, imp.impactDescription, imp.verifiedImpactScope

questions.question: 38.890이 38.401과 38.423에 미친 영향은?
questions.cypher: MATCH (tr:TechnicalReport {trNumber: '38.890'})-[:HAS_TR_IMPACT]->(imp:TRImpact{evidenceStatus: 'source_verified'})-[:IMPACTS_SPEC]->(s:Spec) WHERE s.specNumber IN ['38.401', '38.423'] RETURN s.specNumber, imp.impactType, imp.impactDescription, imp.verifiedImpactScope

questions.question: Rel-17 타겟 TR과 TS 영향 유형?
questions.cypher:
MATCH (tr:TechnicalReport)-[:TARGET_RELEASE]->(r:Release {releaseName: 'Rel-17'})
                  OPTIONAL MATCH (tr)-[:HAS_TR_IMPACT]->(imp:TRImpact{evidenceStatus: 'source_verified'})-[:IMPACTS_SPEC]->(s:Spec)
                  RETURN tr.trNumber, tr.trTitle, collect({spec: s.specNumber, type: imp.impactType, verifiedScope: imp.verifiedImpactScope}) AS impacts

questions.question: 38.879의 결론과 TS 반영은?
questions.cypher: MATCH (tr:TechnicalReport {trNumber: '38.879'}) OPTIONAL MATCH (tr)-[:HAS_TR_IMPACT]->(imp:TRImpact{evidenceStatus: 'source_verified'})-[:IMPACTS_SPEC]->(s:Spec) RETURN tr.conclusions, s.specNumber, imp.impactType, imp.verifiedImpactScope

questions.question: TR 간 참조 관계 존재 확인 (outgoing)
questions.cypher: MATCH (tr:TechnicalReport)-[r:REFERENCES_TR]->(other:TechnicalReport) RETURN DISTINCT tr.trNumber AS src, other.trNumber AS tgt ORDER BY src LIMIT 10
questions.note: RAN3 TR References 절이 인용한 TR 중 이 코퍼스에 있는 것은 2건(38.806→38.801 · 38.816→38.801)이고, 01_parse_tr_docs.py 의 extract_tr_references 가 이를 referencesTR 로 뽑아 01_load_tr_ontology.py 가 REFERENCES_TR 로 적재한다. 원본 count(r) 쿼리는 항상 1행을 돌려 행 수 판정을 무효로 만들었으므로 참조 쌍을 행으로 돌려준다.

questions.question: TR 간 역참조 존재 확인 (incoming)
questions.cypher: MATCH (tr:TechnicalReport)<-[r:REFERENCES_TR]-(other:TechnicalReport) RETURN DISTINCT tr.trNumber AS target, other.trNumber AS referrer ORDER BY target LIMIT 10
questions.note: RAN3 TR References 절이 인용한 TR 중 이 코퍼스에 있는 것은 2건(38.806→38.801 · 38.816→38.801)이고, 01_parse_tr_docs.py 의 extract_tr_references 가 이를 referencesTR 로 뽑아 01_load_tr_ontology.py 가 REFERENCES_TR 로 적재한다. 원본 count(r) 쿼리는 항상 1행을 돌려 행 수 판정을 무효로 만들었으므로 참조 쌍을 행으로 돌려준다. 역방향(incoming)으로 같은 두 쌍을 확인한다.

questions.question: HAS_TR_IMPACT가 가장 많은 TR Top 5
questions.cypher: MATCH (tr:TechnicalReport)-[:HAS_TR_IMPACT]->(imp:TRImpact) RETURN tr.trNumber, count(imp) AS cnt, collect({claimType: imp.impactType, evidenceStatus: imp.evidenceStatus, verifiedScope: imp.verifiedImpactScope}) AS claims ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 5
